purpose: Map current grounded-QA distillation artifacts to manuscript claims, tables, and blocked claims without overclaiming missing Qwen 3B results.

dataset_and_temporal_claims.allowed_claim: The final evaluation window is a public, dated arXiv/QASPER proxy for an evolving domain KB, not a private enterprise KB.

zero_call_risk_gate_transfer.scope: extended_temporal_future_holdout examples 241-389, excluding the threshold-selection window
zero_call_risk_gate_transfer.interpretation: Support-aware zero-call gating improves judged correctness and answer support over direct mini repair, but trades off answer coverage and recall.

deterministic_claim_entailment_guard.interpretation: A deterministic claim/evidence guard adds a small support gain over the balanced gate, again by suppressing answers.

mini_verifier_teacher_step.interpretation: The mini verifier is useful as a label-construction or teacher step, not as the final amortized student because it adds per-query LLM calls.

post_training_policy_ablation.qwen3b_acceptance_metric: The trained Qwen3B student must improve support/correctness over direct compact-RAG labels without collapsing answer coverage to the zero-call gate floor.
post_training_policy_ablation.interpretation: Historical judged ablation says support-risk contrast is the strongest data-construction direction, but the final trained student must recover coverage rather than only learning to abstain.

coverage_constrained_frontier.qwen3b_recommended_minimum: Beat the direct baseline on answer support and overall judged correctness while keeping answer rate above 70%; if that is not possible, report the exact coverage/support frontier instead of claiming support-preserving distillation.
coverage_constrained_frontier.interpretation: The support/coverage tradeoff is binding; Qwen 3B should be compared against a 70% answer-rate frontier, not only against the low-coverage support-first gate.

candidate_pool_oracle.interpretation: Even oracle selection among current final-window direct/gate/guard candidates cannot hit the 70% answer-rate target while choosing only supported answers. The next model/data change must learn repair or regeneration, not only selection.

unsupported_answer_repairability.recommendation: Keep the Qwen joint-action packet focused on answer repair/regeneration plus abstention; citation repair alone explains only a minority of unsupported final-window direct answers.
unsupported_answer_repairability.interpretation: Most unsupported direct answers on the final window are not fixed by citation reranking alone; they require answer repair/regeneration or abstention.

faithfulness_ranking_control.interpretation: The lexical faithfulness/ranking filter does not improve inherited final-window correctness over direct repair at the selected 24.0% threshold (50/69 vs 50/69); reviewer-facing retrieval-side controls remain necessary, but they do not replace the Qwen repair/regeneration test.

model_scale_adequacy.interpretation: Tiny/local students are negative controls: they can learn citation shape or abstain, but they do not preserve support. Local Qwen 3B base inference is feasible but still weak on the citation/JSON contract, and deterministic citation repair fixes syntax without proving support. The next credible trained-student evidence is the bounded Qwen 3B joint-action LoRA smoke, not an open-ended larger GPU experiment.

historical_break_even_rows.interpretation: At the observed ledger cost, planned Qwen GPU+judge spend breaks even after about 15242 future queries if the trained zero-call system meets quality gates.
At the observed ledger cost, planned Qwen GPU+judge spend breaks even after about 972 future queries if the trained zero-call system meets quality gates.
At the observed ledger cost, planned Qwen GPU+judge spend breaks even after about 447 future queries if the trained zero-call system meets quality gates.

amortization_break_even.interpretation: The Qwen 3B smoke plus judge remains affordable under the $100 cap, and the amortization argument is now explicit as break-even accounting. It is still conditional on passing the grounded-correctness and coverage gates.

distillation_loss_accounting.interpretation: The current student/scaffold evidence is now framed as preservation and loss: cheap systems preserve some syntax, cost, or support dimensions but lose either coverage, judged support, or contract reliability. The Qwen 3B row must be judged against this contract.

corpus_realism_private_kb_gap.interpretation: The current corpus is an evolving public domain-KB proxy with trusted document dates, not a private enterprise KB. Private-KB generality remains a limitation until a versioned private or enterprise-like corpus is added.

claim_boundary.reason: The source is repository-local product/architecture documentation with immutable git commits, not a confidential enterprise corpus with access-control semantics.

versioned_domain_kb_extension_candidate.interpretation: The git-doc prototype shows how to instantiate immutable train/eval KB snapshots with line-citation examples and stale-snapshot abstentions, but it remains deterministic and not private-enterprise proof.

naive_copy_first.description: Always answer by copying the first retrieved evidence line with its citation, regardless of snapshot staleness.

prefix_retriever_snapshot_guard.description: Use the quoted question prefix to select the matching evidence line, and abstain on stale train-snapshot requests.

versioned_domain_kb_eval.interpretation: On the deterministic git-doc prototype, naive citation-copy over-answers stale snapshot queries, while a snapshot-aware prefix retriever handles both update answers and stale abstentions.

train_only_writeback.description: Retrieve only records written from the train snapshot. This can answer stable facts but cannot know eval-only updates.

train_writeback_plus_live_snapshot.description: Use live snapshot evidence for eval-time questions, train write-back records for stable facts, and abstain on stale train-snapshot requests.

leaky_eval_writeback_upper_bound.description: Invalid upper bound that writes eval-snapshot facts into memory before evaluation.

versioned_writeback_diagnostic.interpretation: Write-back memory is a valid competing amortization family only when records are created from prior snapshots. Train-only memory helps stable facts but cannot replace live retrieval for new updates; eval-written memory leaks future facts and over-answers stale train-snapshot queries.

required_upgrade_artifacts: A natural-question dataset over immutable train/eval KB snapshots, with questions written without quoting target evidence prefixes.
Question provenance: human author, independent teacher model with ledgered calls, or licensed user-query log with privacy review.
Snapshot-specific evidence packs generated by retrieval rather than nearest-line template construction.
Stale/missing-evidence cases that arise from real update timing or retrieval insufficiency, not only withheld eval-line templates.
Baselines over the natural questions: direct compact RAG, snapshot-aware retrieval guard, WriteBack memory with prior-snapshot provenance, and trained student/scaffold.
Private or enterprise-like semantics if making a private-KB claim: access-control metadata, confidential-document handling, and redistribution-safe artifacts.
versioned_kb_naturalness_gap.interpretation: The git-doc prototype should be described as a deterministic snapshot diagnostic and upgrade path. It should not be treated as a natural private/domain-KB benchmark until the required upgrade artifacts exist.

versioned_kb_natural_question_probe.interpretation: A single ledgered question-authoring pass removes most deterministic wording leakage while keeping answers/citations anchored to source snapshot labels; it is a benchmark-construction probe, not model evidence.

copy_first_evidence.description: Always answer by copying the first retrieved evidence line with its citation, regardless of snapshot staleness.

lexical_retriever_snapshot_guard.description: Abstain on stale train-snapshot requests; otherwise pick the evidence line with highest natural-question lexical overlap.

key_result.interpretation: The natural-question packet preserves the stale-KB failure mode after removing deterministic prefix wording: naive citation-copy still over-answers stale train-snapshot questions, while snapshot-aware abstention is still required.

versioned_kb_natural_question_eval.interpretation: After natural-question rewriting, naive citation-copy still fails every stale train-snapshot abstention, while a lexical snapshot-aware guard preserves the stale-KB diagnostic with one remaining stable-question retrieval miss.

joint_action_packet_quality.interpretation: The Qwen 3B packet passes a zero-cost pre-launch audit for repair/abstain preference coverage, inline citations, and train/eval paper separation.

joint_action_script_contract.interpretation: The Qwen 3B smoke scripts pass zero-cost local compile, dataset-validator, runner-syntax, bounded-command, and judge-ready-artifact checks before paid GPU launch.

joint_action_smoke_cost_accounting.interpretation: The post-smoke cost finalizer is ready to record actual external compute spend only after smoke artifacts exist and the $100 budget gate passes.

prime_smoke_runbook.interpretation: The Prime handoff now has explicit auth, live-price, pod-create, sync, bootstrap, fetch, cost-finalize, and terminate steps, but it still cannot run until Prime auth succeeds.

prime_auth_price_gate.interpretation: The live backend gate is now executable; it currently fails closed on Prime auth before wallet or GPU price can be verified.

qwen3b_result_integration_gate.target: answer_rate >= 0.70, answer_support_rate > direct baseline, and overall_judged_correct_rate > direct baseline. Also report deltas to the 70% frontier; beating it is a stronger result, not silently assumed.
qwen3b_result_integration_gate.interpretation: The final Qwen result now has a fail-closed integration gate that will compare it against the direct baseline and 70% coverage-constrained frontier before any Pareto or paper claim. A 100% inline-citation syntax-only fixture is explicitly rejected, and local base/repaired Qwen controls are rejected as final trained-smoke substitutes.

required_remote_provenance: prime_pod_status.json with provider/pod/GPU metadata captured before fetch.
remote_environment.txt with date, uname, nvidia-smi, uv version, and git head.
smoke_manifest.json proving bounded MAX_SFT_STEPS=20, MAX_DPO_STEPS=10, PUSH_TO_HUB=false.
qwen3b_remote_provenance_gate.interpretation: A trained-student result is not judge-ready until it includes Prime pod status, remote environment, bootstrap manifest, and bounded smoke manifest provenance.

drag_like.claim: A DRAG-like comparison should be framed as a close baseline family, but the novel target is support-preserving data construction over evolving/private KBs. The next model result must show whether joint-action SFT/DPO improves support without relying on per-query teacher or verifier calls.

Do not claim compact-memory or federated RAG amortization as the contribution.
Claim model/scaffold-side amortization only after the trained Qwen 3B row passes support, coverage, temporal/update, and cost gates.

citation_faithfulness_neighbor_pressure.headline: Retrieval-side citation faithfulness and verification pipelines are close enough that the paper must avoid broad citation-RAG claims.
claim_boundary: Do not claim first query-decomposition, reranking, or faithfulness-aware context-selection method for citation RAG.
Do not claim academic citation prediction as the task; answer-support evidence citations are different.
Do not present generate-then-verify as the deployed contribution unless the verification cost is included.
The Qwen 3B result must demonstrate generation/repair beyond selection-only verification because the current candidate-pool oracle is coverage-limited.
A lexical cited-evidence faithfulness ranking filter is not enough on the final window because the fixed train-selected threshold makes no final-window improvement.

retrieval_side_control.interpretation: The lexical faithfulness/ranking filter does not improve inherited final-window correctness over direct repair at the selected 24.0% threshold (50/69 vs 50/69); reviewer-facing retrieval-side controls remain necessary, but they do not replace the Qwen repair/regeneration test.

required_after_qwen_smoke: Report whether trained Qwen improves support at >=70% answer rate compared with direct repair, guard/ranking-like filters, and the candidate-pool oracle boundary.
If reviewers press on QDRAG/ranking, report the same-window lexical faithfulness-ranking control and, if Qwen is positive, consider a stronger retrieval-side decomposition/ranking baseline.
If reviewers press on Generate-but-Verify, report online verification cost separately from amortized student/scaffold cost.

writeback_scope.scoped_reason: A mutable write-back memory changes the retrieval corpus and can leak final-window facts unless it is built strictly from prior dated/private snapshots. The current QASPER/arXiv result still has no full write-back baseline; the git-doc snapshot diagnostic is a toy versioned-domain check, not a replacement for the paper-critical Qwen 3B trained-student evaluation.

Joint-action SFT/DPO preserves support better than the zero-call scaffold baselines.

constraints: Use 'model-judged grounded correctness' for current metrics.

judge_reliability_constraints.interpretation: The second-pass judge supports reporting unsupported-answer checks as model-judged screening evidence, but the claim gate keeps human-validated correctness and solved abstention-boundary claims disallowed until priority adjudication rows are closed.

evidence: public arXiv proxy, not private KB

allowed_claims_now: Support-aware local scaffolds can improve judged correctness over direct mini repair on dated QASPER/arXiv future windows, at a clear coverage cost.
Citation formatting alone is insufficient: high inline citation compliance can coexist with very low judged answer support.

A blind second-pass judge agrees with the original support judge on many hard unsupported-answer and sanity-check cases; a disagreement taxonomy and claim gate show remaining disagreements are mostly abstention-boundary reversals and require priority adjudication before uncaveated correctness claims.
The current protocol has a trusted dated public-KB proxy and explicit budget accounting, but not yet the final trained Qwen 3B student result.
The planned Qwen 3B smoke and judge have explicit break-even accounting under the $100 cap, conditioned on the missing quality gate.
The final claim acceptance matrix is executable and currently blocks the trained-student claim until Qwen predictions, paid judging, provenance, Pareto update, and readiness gates pass.
Compact faithful-context QA is a close baseline family; current artifacts position against it but do not replace a true OCC-RAG-like baseline on the same update-heldout splits.

Citation-grounding metrics and compact QA memories are close neighbors; current artifacts position against them but do not replace a true citation-grounding or compact-memory baseline on the final update-heldout window.

Citation-RAG decomposition/ranking, academic citation prediction, and generate-then-verify systems are close neighbors; current artifacts position against them but do not replace a same-window retrieval-side or verifier-side baseline.
A same-window lexical faithfulness-ranking filter is now measured as a zero-call retrieval-side control; it does not improve final-window support-oracle correctness at the train-selected threshold.
An unsupported-answer repairability audit shows final-window direct failures mostly require answer repair/regeneration or abstention, not citation repair alone.
claims_to_avoid_until_qwen3b: A smaller trained model has been shown to preserve citation-grounded correctness.
Joint-action SFT/DPO beats the existing scaffolds.
The work is ready as a NeurIPS submission.
The evaluation proves behavior over private enterprise KBs rather than a public dated proxy.
The git-doc prototype is a natural versioned-KB benchmark rather than a deterministic snapshot diagnostic.

The project is the first compact faithful-context-QA model, citation-grounding metric, compact-memory amortization method, citation-RAG decomposition/ranking method, academic citation prediction benchmark, generate-then-verify RAG method, or enterprise agentic RAG system.
